title: A unified and practical taxonomy for false discovery rate control in omics research - Nature Biotechnology
text:
False discovery rate (FDR) control is central to omics research, yet the diverse procedures used rely on different assumptions. This Comment proposes a 2 × 2 matrix that helps sequencing-based and mass-spectrometry-based omics researchers choose the appropriate family of FDR procedures, or alternative methods that may be more rigorous, depending on data and study design.
